patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "khosla ventures", 2026-09-13

profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit firm founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Its website describes it as investing in the company best positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence. The site also describes backing a broad, category-defining finance workflow platform, citing tailwinds, proprietary data and AI talent as the basis for that effort.

The material published on the site includes commentary on AI's economic effects. One item argues that autonomous driving in closed systems is now easy to do and deploy, and that this should raise questions about new infrastructure projects involving high speed rail. Another proposes eliminating preferential capital gains treatment after 2028 and taxing such gains as ordinary income, stating that this could generate approximately $400B per year, and argues that the labor portion of the economy will decline sharply relative to capital.

Its recorded legal exposure is in California, with a count of 237.
